decision_rule_text: E (immediate-physical joint world model) is recommended as the shared encoder for specialist / Rewarded Soups training only if, on the FRESH test factories at the matched 60-epoch budget, ALL hold: (1) vs C: latent change explained (changed tokens) >= C - 0.02, same-operation/other-machine discrimination >= C + 0.10, actual-state availability same-operation difference sign accuracy >= C + 0.10; (2) vs D: same-operation/other-machine discrimination, overall discrimination and availability sign accuracy each >= D - 0.02, and the relational-probe mean (pair earliest start R^2, best-machine accuracy, machine earliest start R^2) >= D's; (3) vs B: relational-probe mean >= B + 0.02 and E's mean changed-entity change MAE <= 1.10 x B's; (4) physical quality: E's sibling-difference MAE below the zero-difference baseline in every target group, and changed-entity change R^2 >= 0.5 for machine free time, job ready time and decision-time advance; (5) E not collapsed. Final-outcome probes are reported but are not part of the rule.
target_frame: minutes; F, R and T relative to S_t's decision time t_t; B, W absolute; z-scored per group with training-split mean and std

dropped_as_redundant.machine energy / carbon: gamma * P_m * B_m / 60 (carbon is processing energy only; checked)
dropped_as_redundant.job completion lower bound: R_j + W_j (checked against op_ct_lb of the job's last operation)
dropped_as_redundant.remaining operation count: same information as W_j (which operations are scheduled)

splits.unused: joint pilot test factories (informed this redesign)
